prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for most change kinds, as only adoption new_flow, choose_path copy, choose_path layout, finish new_screen, home new_flow, and sign_in hint have at least two tests.
choose_path copy and finish new_screen changes did not work, showing no clear effect or worse performance across all tests.
home new_flow, sign_in hint, choose_path layout, and adoption new_flow can be helpful change types since each produced at least one winning test, though several tests showed no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too high overall, but consistently underestimated results for home new_flow.

Changes:
0: [home, new_flow] Desktop Pet Audio Calibration Flow: Adds an audio testing workspace to the waiting screen while the pet is generating on desktop. (why: The waiting step (home) takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s. Interactive flows during home waiting have shown positive test results.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Cloud Backup Security Hint: Displays a clear hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in prevents pets from being reset or lost. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again, and sign_in hints are a proven winning change type.)
2: [choose_path, layout] Split Screen Path Selector Layout: Changes the choose_path screen layout to a side-by-side split layout comparing companion options. (why: choose_path has a 21.2% drop-off rate, and choose_path layout changes have previously produced successful tests.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Photo Alignment Calibration Flow: Introduces an interactive photo calibration tools step during photo upload so users can preview framing. (why: Adoption has a 36.7% drop-off and support mail reported custom pet generation failures and visual glitches. Adoption new_flow is a proven effective change type.)
4: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet System Tray Controls Welcome Screen: Adds a dedicated welcome sub-screen following home_intro demonstrating system tray pet controls. (why: Multiple support tickets mentioned confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)
5: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Certificate Finalization Status: Displays progress indicator status and a step counter on the adoption certificate screen while processing. (why: Adoption has a high median completion time of 89s (mean 1017s) and 36.7% drop-off.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Ready Audio Alert: Enables background notifications on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet desktop generation completes. (why: Users spend a median of 201s and mean of 2336s on the waiting screen, indicating the app is often left idle in the background.)
7: [adoption, redesign] Desktop Pet Selection Stage Workspace: Redesigns the pick_friend screen using a stage layout with choice cards for companion options. (why: Adoption step has the highest drop-off rate (36.7%) and redesigning key selection screens improves visual clarity.)
